items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: So Al got me to my therapy classes and I did a lot of praying.

ctx.x: I can say this, when I retired from teaching school you know I taught a long time, and my family’s just — my mother went ‘92, then I went to Europe in ’94, and I said well I’m out of school now I can get back to really performing. Then my son was taken sick and he passed in ’96. And oh God, that was — I won’t even talk about it too much. And there was some malpractice involved and that made it even worse. He had a perforated intestine and they just messed all over it, so it made it very difficult for me. I was in…
My minister prayed with me much, and there were times when I thought I couldn’t make it.
